title: Follow the corridor
introduction: Deliver a coin through two legs whose lengths vary.
explanation: while checks a condition before every iteration. It repeats while the condition is true and may run zero times. A move changes the world, so the next sensor result may differ.
objective: Reach the far end of the L-shaped corridor and place your coin there. Finish facing north with an empty bag.
instruction: Use sensor-controlled while loops for both straight legs. Turn left once at the corner. One world starts at that corner.

commands.description: Keep moving until the next step would hit a wall.

hints: You do not need to count the squares.
Complete the first leg, turn left, then use the same strategy on the second.
Place the coin after the second loop ends, not inside it.

illustration.alt: A while loop checks the path before every step. At a wall the straight walk stops; the next command can turn into another leg.
